finding.row_is_fill_behavior: BUY, SELL, FILL, EXIT and SETTLE-like actions are all classified as fills
finding.row_has_realized_pnl_behavior: any non-empty net_pnl field is classified as realized even on entry/partial rows

economic_implication: Minimum-fill and minimum-realized-PnL observation gates can be satisfied by duplicated lifecycle rows rather than unique mature executions, so PAPER_ELIGIBLE evidence can be overstated before fill-conditioned PnL is actually established.
required_successor: Use canonical unique order/fill identifiers for fill observations and do not count exits/settles as additional entry fills.
Count realized PnL only on explicit terminal close/unwind/settle/bundle-terminal records; entry and partial rows remain censored.
Use compatible unique denominators for fill-rate estimation.
For multi-leg evidence, key by bundle_id/leg_id/fill_id and preserve joint partial/completion state rather than row counts.
Re-run the same-SHA PAPER evidence gates after the accounting repair before interpreting fills or fill-conditioned PnL.
